ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, filled buttons, nav strokes, icon fills — near-black rather than pure black to soften the interface

paper.$description: Paper — Base canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

bone.$description: Bone — Warm off-white secondary surface, subtle background tints behind sections

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted helper text, secondary button text, disabled labels

carbon.$description: Carbon — Pure black reserved for icon fills and maximum-contrast accents

iris.$description: Iris — Primary chromatic accent — data bar fills, brand gradient anchor, link color — violet carries the only sustained saturation in the UI; Sole vivid accent — horizontal bar chart fills, hero gradient, brand wordmark moments

blush.$description: Blush — Pastel pink surface wash — category tile backgrounds, data card tints

rose-mist.$description: Rose Mist — Softest pink surface — subtle section tints, card backgrounds

meringue.$description: Meringue — Warm peach surface — category tiles, dataset swatches, complementary pastel

mint.$description: Mint — Mint pastel surface — category tiles, complementary data swatch

seafoam.$description: Seafoam — Green-tinted pastel surface — category swatch, soft data background

slate-plum.$description: Slate Plum — Cool dark plum for body text and dark-on-light icon strokes

fellix.$description: Primary interface and display typeface — geometric grotesque with unusually low contrast; weight 520 is a near-medium custom step that gives headlines substance without going bold, weight 400 handles body. Tracking sits tight at -0.025em across the scale, which is anti-convention for a sans and makes even 48px headlines feel compact and scientific rather than airy or editorial.

pp-fraktion-mono.$description: Monospace lab-label voice — uppercase column headers, tag chips, dataset captions, metric labels. Tracking opens up to +0.025em and ligatures/contextual alternates are explicitly disabled, producing a deliberately clinical, index-card feel that contrasts the tight sans. The 'COMBINED', 'DATASET COMPOSITION', 'BLOG POST' eyebrows are the signature use.
